notes:
v0.6.36: install libcap2-bin + setcap cap_net_bind_service on python3.

The v0.6.35 port layout (launcher :80, wizard :8080) revealed
a second issue: the launcher runs as User=pi, and pi on the
ReticulumHF base has no CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Binding to :80
fails with "PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied".

g90digi has been running on :80 for months because someone
hand-installed libcap2-bin and ran:

  sudo setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep /usr/bin/python3.11

The fresh build didn't have that step. Fix:

- Bootstrap apt block now installs libcap2-bin.
- After the apt install, bootstrap grants python3.11 the
  cap_net_bind_service capability via setcap. This is the
  standard "let a non-root process bind privileged ports"
  pattern — the cap only applies to socket bind(), nothing
  else.

Effect: launcher binds to :80 as User=pi. g90digi layout
(launcher :80, wizard :8080, wifi :8081) is now reproducible
from a fresh flash.
